Name: Shemaah the Gibeathite
Summary: Father of Ahiezer and Joash who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: Father of Ahiezer and Joash who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shemaah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
